findings: Toilet fill valve failing; tank runs continuously.
scope_of_work: Shut off supply; replace fill valve and flapper; test and adjust water level; clean area.

findings: Braided supply line under the kitchen sink is corroded and actively leaking.
recommendation: Replace braided supply line and compression fittings.
scope_of_work: Remove damaged supply line; install new braided line and compression fittings; pressure test; verify no leaks; clean work area.

findings: Condenser fan motor seized; unit not cooling.
recommendation: Replace condenser fan motor and capacitor.
scope_of_work: Replace condenser fan motor and run capacitor; verify amperage and cooling.
